note: Photos for Brightline Home's sample recall BH-2026-01, which is fictional: one real laptop charger by Dmitry G on Wikimedia Commons (public domain, PD-self). cord-cut.jpg shows its cord cut; the other two show the same charger opened up with its cord still attached, so not yet made safe the way the recall asks. Each is exactly as photographed, saved again as JPEG without camera metadata. The charger's maker has not recalled it.
